title: Welcome to Lampy Paperwork V55
paragraphs: Create and manage your show paperwork in one browser workspace: Fixture Patch, Power, Control, Network, Rack Layout, Looms and Labels.

V55 adds PDF Page Settings and PDF File Names under Project Settings → Exports. Choose three filename parts for all documents or create document-specific structures. Every PDF preview shows the filename and lets you save a different structure for that document. First-page settings and their preview collapse together; footer typography is independent.
New: page-specific Help. Look for the circled question mark above Menu at the bottom of the sidebar. Press it on any page for guidance about that page.
The walk-through is temporarily disabled. Use Help whenever you need guidance.
Lampy Paperwork remains under active development. Check your paperwork before use and download regular project-file backups.
